filing_office: Delaware Department of State, Division of Corporations
filing_fee_notes: Formation fee confirmed on the August 2026 official formation instructions; certified copies and expedited services cost extra.
registered_agent_rules: Appoint a registered agent with a Delaware street address to receive service of process.
expedite_options: Expedited services are available; service levels and current charges were not confirmed.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: The dedicated LLC tax instructions and August 2026 formation instructions state an annual tax of 400, due June 1 for the prior calendar year. The general FAQ still states 300; confirm the applicable amount with the Division before payment.
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Formation and maintain a Delaware registered agent. Pay the annual LLC tax even though no annual report is required.
common_mistake: Assuming no annual report means no annual state tax.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Conflicting official annual-tax amounts are disclosed; the newer formation instructions and dedicated tax page agree on 400. Electronic submission gateway does not itself process filings instantly. LLC report name, deadline and filing URL are not applicable. Processing time, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
